lines.text: Rain-slick street. The last night bus idles at the far stop.
@sai_front sprints, bag bouncing, breath fogging under the streetlights.
The doors hiss shut just before he arrives.
The doors open again. The driver waves him on.
Take your time. I'm not going anywhere.
@sai_front climbs aboard, out of breath, grinning.

writes.note: I drafted a short night-bus scene from your line, with one line for the driver.

reply.rationale: Expanded the person's single beat into one location, six short action lines and one spoken line, about 14.8 s by rule 10. Kept @sai_front as written.
